newsitem.title: VATICAN: Vatican and Libya to establish diplomatic ties.
newsitem.headline: Vatican and Libya to establish diplomatic ties.

text.p: The Vatican said on Monday it had agreed to establish full diplomatic relations with Libya.
A statement issued by the Vatican said the two states wanted to develop "mutual friendly relations".

"The Holy See and...Libya, wanting to develop mutual friendly relations, have decided by common agreement to stabilise their diplomatic relations at level of apostolic nuncio by the Vatican and ambassador by Libya," the Vatican said.
The statement said Pope John Paul had appointed Archbishop Jose Sebastian Laboa as the Vatican's nuncio, or ambassador, to Libya. He had been the Holy See's ambassador to Malta.
